presentation: Upload, confirmations, and processing stay in the modal. A fresh completed report status closes it and returns to Free Result. The same continuation component uses the same versioned checkout payload.
protectedChangeReason: Explicit customer request to disable manual approval for payment; existing eligibility and report release functions remain unchanged.
queryPolicyChange: Free Result observes the existing owner/case-scoped report query and polls unfinished processing while the modal is closed; the modal retains its original query policy.
